question: Which of the following is a replica of the famous Taj Mahal built in 1679?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bibi's Tomb.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Bibi Ka Maqbara or **Bibi's Tomb** is a tomb built during the Mughal period in India

 
 
• It is located in Aurangabad, Maharashtra.
 
• Bibi Ka Maqbara was commissioned by the sixth Mughal emperor Aurangzeb in 1660.
 
• Aurangzeb commissioned the Bibi Ka Maqbara in memory of his wife Dilras Banu Begum.
 
 
 
• Due to its resemblance to the Taj Mahal, Bibi Ka Maqbara is also known as the ‘Taj of the Deccan’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Allahabad Fort **was built by the Mughal emperor Akbar at Allahabad in 1583.
 
• **Zeenat-Un-Mosque **was built by Zeenat-un-Nisa, the daughter of Aurangzeb in 1700 AD
